skill_name: How has the internet changed communication among people?
workflow: The internet has drastically changed the way people communicate and has revolutionized the way information is shared. Communication between people has become much faster, more efficient and more cost effective due to the internet. On a global level, the internet has connected people from all backgrounds, making it easier to collaborate on projects and exchange ideas.
